boundary.scope: Exact IEEE bits, including signed zero, normal/subnormal exponent boundaries and cancellation within the unchanged Cross public input domain, against pinned source-built C3.17 FP-contraction-off. Test-only unchecked conversion transports bits; it is not a trusted production or proof body.

limitations: Instrumented gprof sampling is diagnostic, not release timing or phase attribution of the C gap.
Sampling and call counts cover the full process, including setup, reset and I/O. Shared-library time is outside the main-image histogram.
Instrumentation changes layout and call overhead; inlining attributes work to containing symbols.
No C phase profile or matched-build parity claim.

automatic-inline.scope: Static instruction/call sites, not dynamic phase attribution. Inlining can remove the standalone body.

no-inline.scope: Static instruction/call sites, not dynamic phase attribution. Inlining can remove the standalone body.

decision: Neither private Cross variant adopted: automatic inlining regresses fixed tendons; No_Inline loses multi-DOF gains. Final working code stays r455.
